Definition: perhaps from the same as G3735 (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity):--air, heaven(-ly), sky.
BiblicalUsage: Heaven is the dwelling of God, the home of the saints, and the sky above us. Jesus taught us to pray, Our Father which art in heaven, Peter says our inheritance is incorruptible and reserved in heaven, and Paul says we wait for God's Son from heaven, and have a house eternal in the heavens.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe heaven is not a vague hope but a place and a Person: our Father is there, our inheritance is reserved there, and our home is eternal there. And one day the heaven that feels so far away will be my home, with the Father I already know.
